methods: Imported verifyEvidence for metadata/content consistency only; no replay or candidate execution.
SHA-256 compared each pinned source file with the exact git commit object.
Parsed repeated observations and nested Docker lifecycle records; reconciled their IDs and candidate usage.
Calculated token-rate cost from recorded provider usage; did not query authoritative billing.

Source digest uses the complete operational lock, per apps/api/src/live-application.ts:44-45; candidate measured costs remain null while aggregate estimate is finalized per packages/orchestrator/src/live-local.ts:132-135.
limitations: Artifact consistency is not independent authentication of provider responses or recorded Docker events.
Actual inference provenance and cleanup are recorded evidence only; no network, provider, Docker, replay, private account or .local access occurred.
All original and candidate observations are import/serialization errors, so these artifacts cannot establish repair correctness or comparative performance.
The driver error code does not identify the underlying exception; workspace permissions or another cause require separate controlled diagnosis.
CPU consumption remains null and authoritative billing remains unknown; the token-rate total is only an estimate.
No sealed evaluation, human reviewer or competition readiness claim is established.
